GameConditionDef.label: Green Rain
GameConditionDef.description: Strange green rain washes over the fields, causing plants to grow wildly.
GameConditionDef.letterText: The sky turned green and it started to rain...

GameConditionDef.label: Tesla EMP field
GameConditionDef.description: A map-wide electromagnetic field released by a failed Tesla Nova generator. All electrical devices are disabled and mechanoids are stunned until the generator is repaired.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The EMP field has collapsed. Electrical systems are coming back online.
